      "source": "Attack the target with either your ranged or melee weapons for %d%% damage.\n\t\tIf the attack hits you'll breach the target's immunities, reducing armor hardiness, stun, pin, blindness, and confusion immunity by 50%% for %d turns.\n\t\tBreach chance scales with your Spellpower.",

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/psionic/nightmare.lua",
      "source": "Brings the target's inner demons to the surface.  Each turn, for %d turns, there's a %d%% chance that a demon will surface, requiring the target to make a Mental Save to keep it from manifesting.\n\t\tIf the target is sleeping, the chance to save will be halved, and fear immunity will be ignored.  Otherwise, if the summoning is resisted, the effect will end early.\n\t\tThe summon chance will scale with your Mindpower and the demon's life will scale with the target's rank.\n\t\tIf a demon manifests the sheer terror will remove all sleep effects from the victim, but not the Inner Demons.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "使目标的心魔浮现。在 %d 回合内，每回合有 %d%% 的几率会召唤一个心魔，需要目标进行一次精神豁免鉴定，失败则心魔具现化。\n\t\t如果目标处于睡眠状态，不出现心魔的几率减半，心魔出现时目标无法豁免，且无视目标的恐惧免疫。若目标未处于睡眠状态且豁免鉴定成功，则心魔的效果提前结束。\n\t\t受精神强度影响，召唤几率按比例加成；心魔的生命值受目标分级加成。\n\t\t心魔具现化时，会移除目标身上至多 3 个睡眠类效果，本技能除外。"

If you're not adjacent to the target, you'll step forward as you spin, gaining up to %d%% bonus damage, which increases the farther you move.\n\t\tThis attack will remove any grapples you're maintaining, and earn one combo point (or one combo point per attack that connects, if the talent level is 4 or greater).",
